svg.text: Discussion lifecycle: states, checkpoints, Resume, Start fresh, Archive & Defer — src/ui.mjs (2026-11-13)
On the browser screen, several discussions can be open at once in a folder (each in its own context #d1, #d2…), plus at most one brainstorm.
1. Unstarted context (/new or launch)
• No folder, transcript or checkpoint on disk yet
• Screen /new: opens beside open discussions;
ends any open brainstorm (if no worker hold)
• Settings changes apply directly before 1st message
• Worker tasks before 1st message use worker/main
• Valid 1st message → openDiscussion():
claudeTitle() (30s) → mkdir + session-*.md
1st msg
2. Brainstorm (/brainstorm)
• At most one open per folder (state.brainstorm)
• Lives in server RAM only: no folder, no transcript,
no checkpoint, no auto dev, no file attachments
• Briefing asks agents to write no files
• Worker uses shared <repo>.worker/ (worker/main)
• Survives Reload & page refresh; lost on Restart,
Quit room, /close, /new or another /brainstorm
3. Open discussion (in use / open beside)
• Folder: discussions/<date-title>/
• Current session log: transcripts/session-*.md
• Own agent sessions + worker session (workerSeat)
• Worktree: <repo>.workers/<name>/
(on branch worker/<name>, own queue)
• Saves checkpoint after every round, /summary,
worker task, and on endSession() (Close, Quit, Restart)
• /close: refuses on workerHold() or replica owner;
otherwise calls endSession() & detachWorker()
(in-flight worker tasks finish & save to checkpoint)
saveCheckpoint() / Close / Restart
Resume / 1st msg
4a. Resume with full checkpoint (/resume <name>, or Restart)
• Checkpoint file: ~/.local/state/agent-room/paused/<rootHash>/<nameHash>.json
• If already open in another context of this folder: goto() shows it as-is
• If in archive/ or deferred/: moved back to discussions/<name>/ first
• loadCheckpoint() validates version, root, transcript file & provider session IDs:
– Restores same CLI sessions, chat, seen map, token totals & same session-*.md file
– Reattaches live worker if still running (reattachWorker); else restores worker session
– Adds state.restored notice to each agent's next prompt ("restored from checkpoint…")
– If transcript file grew after checkpoint (logBytes): warns User with line number
– reportWork() reports any interrupted or unstarted worker tasks in chat & Worker tab
• If checkpoint or provider session is invalid/missing: kept on disk, error suggests Start fresh
(Resume never silently starts a fresh session).
4b. Start fresh (/fresh <name>) or Resume without checkpoint
• /fresh <name>: saves then discards old CLI sessions & chat; extracts latest Summary
• Writes a small checkpoint (fresh: true) holding only summary & work until round 1
• /resume <name> when no full checkpoint exists also enters this state (continued: true)
• On the User's next message (openDiscussion(), no new title requested):
– Creates a new transcripts/session-YYYY-MM-DD-HHMM.md file (older ones stay)
– Starts fresh agent & worker CLI sessions
– briefing() tells agents this continues discussions/<name>/, instructs them to start
from handoff.md, and appends the saved freshSummary (marked if not agreed)
• Handoff convention (brainstorming rulebook, followed by agents in turn order):
– 1st agent reads handoff.md, marks Delivery read, renames to handoff-read-*.md,
and announces path; other agents read that archive and record their names.
/move, Archive, Defer, /rollback
5. Moving discussions: discussions/archive/<name>/ & discussions/deferred/<name>/ (moveDiscussion in src/ui.mjs)
Common guards (enforced before any move):
• Refused if shown in this room context (ctx.discussion.dir === from)
• Refused if a round is running (open.busy), a worker task is writing to it,
or it holds unresolved worker edits (workerHold). Open siblings update live.
Defer guard (/move <name> deferred):
• Also refused if worker/<name> or worker/main has commits for <name>
not merged into main. Merging into main clears the guard.
• Make active (/move archive|deferred/<name> active), /resume or
/fresh moves the folder back to discussions/<name>/.
Archive with rollback (/rollback <name> → /archive-rollback <name>):
1. /rollback <name> queues a worker task on worker/<name> (blocks plain Archive)
2. Worker inspects worker/<name>, main & worker/main; stops before editing if
set or dependencies are ambiguous; otherwise merges main, reverts [<name>]
implementation commits newest-first, runs npm test, commits with rollback trailers
3. Harness checks clean tree, HEAD & trailer from Rollback ready: <sha>
4. User reviews report, switches away, and runs /archive-rollback <name>
(re-verifies HEAD before moving folder to discussions/archive/).
User still merges worker/<name> into main manually.
Harness-enforced state & guards (src/ui.mjs)
Active discussion state
Amber = Agent convention from rulebook (asked, not enforced)
